title: Monotonicity of space under appended choices
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, let $w$ and $w'$ be finite choice words, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. The total number of distinct work-tape cells visited during the run from $c$ under $w$ is at most the number visited under the concatenated choice word $ww'$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes
A configuration $c$ on a fixed input
